title: Running the PTC-0200 DNA Engine
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.in7cdhn
materials: Select YES or NO for heated lid

steps.title: Create a New Program
steps.instruction: Initiate the creation of a new program on the PTC-0200 DNA Engine.

substeps.instruction: Press ENTER to create a new program

steps.title: Name the Program
steps.instruction: Assign a name to the program using the selection keys.

substeps.instruction: Use the right SELECT key or the left SELECT key to scroll through characters
Press PROCEED when the desired character is displayed
Press PROCEED once the name is complete

steps.title: Configure Program Steps
steps.instruction: Enter the specific parameters for each step of the program.

substeps.instruction: Input steps using the following options: TEMP, GRADIENT, GOTO, RAMP, END

steps.title: Save the Program
steps.instruction: Save the configured program to a specific folder.

substeps.instruction: Select the desired folder to save to

steps.title: Run a Protocol
steps.instruction: Load and execute a saved protocol.

substeps.instruction: Select a folder containing the protocol you wish to run
The program will begin to run

steps.title: Cancel Program Execution
steps.instruction: Stop a running program if necessary.
